reuse.why: The change reuses budget writes, sheet access and undo wrappers, but implements tag recognition locally instead of using shared/tags.ts.

duplication.why: Category eligibility is repeated across six actions in SQL and TypeScript, alongside a separate implementation of shared tag parsing.

placement.why: Budget operations and handler registration follow existing layers, but tag syntax belongs in the existing shared tags module.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on the requested month-wide actions, their registration and supporting tests.

maintainability.why: Future exclusion changes require coordinated edits across six selection paths, while the tag-parser comment explicitly creates another synchronization obligation.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts:isFixedGroup reimplements tag recognition provided by shared/tags.ts:extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: The same eligibility decision appears as SQL predicates in setLastMonthSpending and the average actions, but as projected flags and TypeScript guards in setZero and copyPreviousMonth.

abstraction_drift.where: isFixedGroup bypasses the existing shared tag parser; successive eligibility changes spread across six actions without a shared selection definition.
